title: Extend shared contracts and safe entrypoint
non_scope: No local or remote model weight training
No unilateral source corpus or pre-existing database mutation
No modification of SillyTavern runtime configuration
acceptance_criteria: Invalid records, stale locators and out-of-scope paths fail closed with specific reasons.
Unicode names, quotes, newlines, units and source offsets round-trip without factual truncation.
Inspect/import has no writes to original corpus assets, live vaults, DBs or runtime stores.

inspect exercises the real corpus read-only; invalid config, output collisions and unavailable-stage dispatch fail closed. Positive run/replay/export/qualification proofs remain mandatory in their owning frames.
description: Establish a single validated contract from source evidence to dataset release using existing Python seams.
